title: The Host finds blocks line by line and reads only the literal language `action-card`, while the Chat client hides every `action-card` block it renders. A block in a block quote, one indented four or more spaces in a nested list item, or one...

attrs.text: The Host finds blocks line by line and reads only the literal language `action-card`, while the Chat client hides every `action-card` block it renders. A block in a block quote, one indented four or more spaces in a nested list item, or one whose language is written with an escape or a character reference, is hidden and offers no card; a block inside an HTML block or a `$$` or `\[ … \]` math block offers a card while its text stays visible. The skills ask for one top-level block at the end of the answer.
